It is located in the settlement of Rõuge in Rõuge Parish, Võru County. It is the deepest lake in Estonia.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 14.7 hectares (36 acres). The lake has an average depth of 13.2 meters (43 ft) and a maximum depth of 38.0 meters (124.7 ft). It is 610 meters (2,000 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 1,610 meters (5,280 ft). It has a volume of 1,994,000 cubic meters (70,400,000 cu ft).
